title: Fleet-Size Bonus by Commercial Service Account
content:
**Fleet program bulletin, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement**

The size of the buyer's registered fleet adds a fleet-size bonus to the fleet unit incentive. Fleet size is shown by the tier of the buyer's commercial service account under **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**, and the bonus is read from that account's tier and status.

| Buyer's service account | Fleet-size bonus |
|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30, active status | USD 350.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15, active status | USD 150.00 |
| Any other buyer | none |

## Clause

A buyer holding a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 in active status earns a fleet-size bonus of 350.00. A buyer holding a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 in active status earns 150.00. Every other buyer earns no fleet-size bonus.

## Points of judgement

- **The account must be in active status.** A Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 or Net 15 that is on credit hold or closed earns no fleet-size bonus.
- **Only the two commercial tiers count.** A buyer with no service account, or with a service account of any other tier, earns no fleet-size bonus.
- **Hypothetical case.** A fleet buyer's active Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 is placed on credit hold. While the account is on hold, the bonus is none. Once the account is back in active status, the bonus is 150.00.
